title: WHO International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health

block.how: every row of WHO's tabulation SimpleTabulation-ICF-en.txt, byte for byte as the 2026-01 release publishes it, is an entity of site/person/icf.mjs with the row's code, title and URIs (generators/person icf and icfmodule write it and GN-01 holds it), and the suite reads the model back against the tabulation
